criteria.gap: Retention is stated only for case data (7 years); state the retention period for tax-identifier hashes, dates of birth and contact data as well.

criteria.evidence: all transport is HTTPS/TLS 1.2+ behind the enterprise gateway; the database file and the document vault are encrypted at rest with keys owned by the shared key-management service (`shared-kms-crypto`); no secret or key is committed to source; configuration comes from environment variables.

every state transition, agent assignment or removal, suspension change, print action and denied attempt appends an event with actor role, actor identifier, action, from-state, to-state, reason and UTC time; events are append-only and readable by Licensing Staff (full) and by the owning buyer (their own application's transitions).

Text contrast ≥ 4.5:1 and large text / UI component contrast ≥ 3:1 using the style-guide tokens (navy `#002855`, action blue `#1A73E8`, green `#1E8E3E`, amber `#F9AB00`, red `#D93025` on white); every status (draft, submitted, issued, rejected, suspended, shortfall) is conveyed by a text label and an icon glyph, never by colour alone.

Full keyboard operability: every control is reachable in DOM order with Tab/Shift+Tab and operable with Enter/Space; tabs use the arrow keys; dialogs close with Escape; a "Skip to main content" link is the first focusable element; no keyboard trap and no positive `tabindex`.

a visible 3 px focus ring (`#1A73E8`, offset 2 px) on every control; opening a dialog moves focus to its heading and returns focus to the trigger on close; after a submit the focus moves to the first invalid field or to the confirmation banner; a view change moves focus to the new view heading.

every input has a visible `<label for>`; icon-only buttons carry `aria-label`; landmarks `header`, `nav`, `main` exist exactly once; exactly one `h1` with a logical `h2`/`h3` hierarchy; data tables use `<th scope>`; the document has `lang="en"`.

the validation banner uses `role="alert"` (assertive); the status badge, the live bond calculation and the fee calculation use `role="status"` / `aria-live="polite"`; announcements are deliberate — one region per view.

each validation error names the field, describes the problem in plain language and states the concrete fix (messages VAL-01…VAL-12); the field receives `aria-invalid="true"` and `aria-describedby` pointing at the message; a summary appears at the top of the step.

criteria.evidence: a static HTML/JavaScript single-page frontend (`frontend.kind = static-html`), a Python standard-library HTTP backend (`backend.kind = python-stdlib-http`) that serves the UI and the JSON API on one port (8767) with `GET /health`, and a SQLite database (`database.kind = sqlite`) created from `src/db/schema.sql`

Normalised 3NF schema: tables in business `snake_case` with surrogate primary keys, foreign keys, unique constraints (`license_number`, buyer + year), `CHECK` constraints restricting `status` to the §3.3 codes and `relationship` to OWNER / AGENT, audit columns, and indexes for the queue and registry queries

`design/solution_design.md` contains an OpenAPI 3.1 document with one operation per §3.3 trigger (`submit`, `issue`, `reject`), read operations for queue, application, agents, documents, reports and history, and calculation endpoints for BR-01 and BR-03; enums equal the §3.3 state codes; every 4xx response carries a `message` the UI can show verbatim; transition operations validate (fromState, trigger, role) server-side and return 409 (illegal state) or 403 (role)

API responses expose display models only — state label and code pair, masked identifier, formatted amounts — and never persistence rows; internal keys other than the application number, hashes and audit columns are marked `x-internal` and excluded; templates bind only to ViewModels.

every interactive control and status display carries a stable kebab-case `data-testid` declared first in `test/test_cases.json` (contract-first) and named by role, entity, action or transition (for example `submit-application-btn`, `issue-licence-btn`, `application-status`); the role switcher is `data-testid="role-switcher"`.

See `specs/traceability_matrix.md` — every `REQ-*` above maps to capability → business rules → planned story → test category; the traceability matrix is maintained with this specification and audited by the Stage 2 lint and the Stage 3 backlog audit.

no legacy table, form, report, query or control identifier appears in target code, schema or UI; no desktop-database bridge, dual-run adapter or compatibility view is built; data moves once through the ETL described in `design/data_migration_and_cutover.md`, after which the legacy database and the old web application are retired.
